basic_info.description:
Welcome to Waterfront Luxury at The Shipyard modern design with panoramic Bay views.

This penthouse top-floor corner residence at 52 Kirkwood Avenue, Unit #426, part of Lennar's premier Madison collection, offers endless views of the sky, clouds, and ocean from every angle.

Step inside this light-filled 1,109 sq. ft. home and experience the perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. Expansive windows frame sweeping vistas of the Bay, Candlestick Park, and the San Bruno Hills, filling every room with natural light and calm coastal energy.

The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas are ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The chef's kitchen features GE stainless steel appliances, Silestone quartz countertops, a Bianca Calcutta backsplash, and a large center island that makes a stunning focal point. Step onto your private balcony to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at sunset with breathtaking views of the Bay and greenway..

Each bedroom sits on opposite sides of the home for ultimate privacy. The primary suite boasts a custom walk-in closet and a spa-inspired en-suite bath with designer finishes. Thoughtful upgrades include high ceilings, hardwood floors, central A/C, premium electric blinds with UV tint, and custom closet organizers.

Exclusive Madison Amenities:

Elegant lobby and resident Pavilion with lounge and fitness center

Dog washing station and secure bike storage

Landscaped courtyard with BBQ area for gatherings

Elevator access and dedicated parking with EV charger

Nestled in the sunniest part of the city, the Hunters PointBayview waterfront offers a peaceful retreat with incredible convenience minutes from downtown San Francisco's rapidly expanding AI corridor and innovation hubs. Enjoy direct access to parks, waterfront trails, UCSF Mission Bay, Dogpatch, and highways 101 & 280 all while being part of one of SF's most exciting growth areas.

52 Kirkwood #426 embodies the best of contemporary waterfront living - stylish, connected, and filled with light.

Amenities:

Top-floor corner residence

Built 2023

Open-concept floor plan

Floor-to-ceiling windows

Private balcony

Bay views

GE stainless steel appliances

Silestone quartz countertops

Large center island

Hardwood floors & high ceilings

Custom walk-in closet

Central A/C

Electric blinds with UV tint

Custom closet organizers

Other key features:

Unit is unfurnished, but can be furnished if needed (at an additional rate). 

Small pets allowed with a $50/month pet fee

Parking: Automatic Garage (adapted for electric charging as well)

Laundry: Washer/Dryer will be provided

Utilities:

Owner covers gas & trash

Tenant responsible for electric, water & sewer

Home Assistance Fee: $35/monthly

We comply with all Fair Housing laws and provide equal housing opportunities. Our first qualified, first approved screening criteria include a 700+ credit score, income at least three times the rent, a move-in date within seven business days of applying, and no pets (service and emotional support animals excepted). Applicants who do not meet these criteria will still be considered based on qualifications rather than the order of application.

By submitting your information on this page you consent to being contacted by the Property Manager and RentEngine via SMS, phone, or email.
